 sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount <> round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,

SELECT w.status, count(*) AS orders, sum(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
 min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS min_order, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS max_order,
 min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS min_disp, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS max_disp,
 count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist
FROM fact_web_order w
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-15' AND DATE '2024-10-15'
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           s.region, s.store_id, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN net_amount END) AS aug_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN net_amount END) AS sep_net,
       count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores
FROM sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
  min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'store_key dup' AS chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT store_key) AS v FROM dim_store
UNION ALL SELECT 'product_key dup', count(*) - count(DISTINCT product_key) FROM dim_product
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact lines without store', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact lines without product', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product s WHERE s.product_key=f.product_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines w/o order', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store lines in Aug-Sep 2024 with 999', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ lines Aug-Sep 2024', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_amount) AS mine FROM mine WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) AS store_id, a.mine, b.ctl, a.mine-b.ctl AS gap
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(a.mine,0)-coalesce(b.ctl,0)) > 0.5
UNION ALL SELECT -1, sum(mine), NULL, NULL FROM a
UNION ALL SELECT -2, NULL, sum(ctl), NULL FROM b

       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END), 2) AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
